name: Filled Etched Phial
summary: In Thunder Bluff, tauren seek a dryad phial of moonwell water. Its rare spiritual power can quench the eternal flame around a sacred centaur relic.

sections.title: Moonwell Waters and Dryad Craft
sections.body: The phial must be filled in night elf territory deep in Ashenvale. Dryads around Raynewood Retreat carry the empty vessels, made to hold pure restorative draughts. A sacred moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River fills one with water bound to celestial and nature power. Night elves regard taking the water without leave as desecration. The tauren need it to face a threat farther south.

sections.title: A Key to Centaur Sorcery
sections.body: Zangen Stonehoof and Rau Cliffrunner sought the water for the deep ties between dryads and centaur. Both trace their ancestry to Cenarius, and their magic shares a primal resonance. In Thousand Needles, the Galak clan guards an ancient relic behind an unyielding protective flame. The flame is said to date from the creation of the centaur race. Moonwell water in the dryad phial can pierce and extinguish the ward.

faq.q: What is inside the Filled Etched Phial?
aliases: what water is in the phial
what is etched phial filled with
faq.answer: The Filled Etched Phial holds sacred water from a night elf moonwell in Ashenvale, near the Falfarren River. Dryads near Raynewood Retreat made the ornate glass vessel.

faq.q: Why do the tauren need moonwell water?
aliases: why does rau need moonwell water
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner needs the sanctified water to pierce and extinguish the protective flame around the Galak centaur relic in Thousand Needles. Dryads and centaur share ancestry through Cenarius, giving the water power against the ancient ward.

faq.q: Where does the empty phial come from?
aliases: where do i find etched phial
faq.answer: Laughing Sisters, dryads who wander the woods around Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale, carry the empty phials.

faq.q: Who do you deliver the Filled Etched Phial to?
faq.answer: After collecting the water, take it first to Zangen Stonehoof on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. He directs you to bring it to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: As a tauren, you strike at the Galak centaur by securing this water, turning Cenarius's shared nature magic against longtime tribal enemies.
As a night elf, you know that taking a dryad's phial and skimming moonwell water by Horde agents violate Ashenvale's holiest sanctuaries.
